name: Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Childhood Associated with a Metabolic Disease
aliases: Childhood Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease due to Metabolic Disorder
Pediatric Metabolic Disease-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Criteria for Childhood Secondary Interstitial Lung Disease Associated with Metabolic Disease

criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of an underlying metabolic disorder known to affect lung tissue
Radiological and/or histopathological evidence of interstitial lung disease
Exclusion of primary childhood interstitial lung diseases not related to metabolic causes
Demonstration of restrictive lung function impairment on pulmonary function testing
Presence of chronic respiratory symptoms such as persistent tachypnea or hypoxemia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Confirmed metabolic disease with compatible interstitial lung disease on imaging or histology, and exclusion of primary ILD
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies on multidisciplinary assessment including metabolic, pulmonary, radiological, and pathological evaluations.

searchTerms: worsening shortness of breath with activity

pathognomonic.symptomName: Persistent hypoxemia at rest or with minimal exertion

searchTerms: chest wall pulling in during breathing
skin sinking between ribs when breathing hard

occasional.symptomName: Mild hepatomegaly related to metabolic disease

laboratory: Elevated serum biomarkers related to underlying metabolic disorder
Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
Possible mild elevation of inflammatory markers
imaging: High-resolution CT showing ground-glass opacities and interstitial thickening
Reticular or nodular infiltrates predominantly in lower lung zones
genetic: Identification of pathogenic variants in genes causing metabolic disorders associated with ILD (e.g., lysosomal storage diseases)
other: Histopathology showing interstitial fibrosis, alveolar septal thickening, and metabolic storage material in lung tissue

redFlags: Failure to respond to standard respiratory therapies
references: Orphanet: Secondary interstitial lung disease specific to childhood associated with a metabolic disease, ORPHA:264719
